settings.label: Location
settings.description:
Your place: its name, or its latitude and longitude with a name after them
Empty: the first line of weather_location.txt in the data folder

settings.label: Other Places
settings.description:
The places of the Other Locations screen, a line each, written as Location is
The lines of weather_location.txt after its first come after these

settings.label: Displays
settings.description: Which screens the forecast loop cycles through

settings.label: Music
settings.description: Background music while the forecast is up: the built-in tracks, unless Music List or weather_music.txt names others

settings.label: Music List
settings.description:
Your own music in place of the built-in tracks, a line each: a stream's or a file's link, or a file's path (from the data folder unless it starts at /)
Empty: weather_music.txt in the data folder, else the built-in tracks

settings.label: Screen Time
settings.description: How long each screen stays up before the loop advances
